title: Blackbox Theater
gap: Prices, hours and eligibility are not copied here yet. We will ask when you request.
blurb: Yes… pretty much so… and usually 18 or older. You generally will need an ID to match you to your ticket. Pictures of ID’s sometimes will be allowed for ticketing purposes. Typically, you must be 18+ to enter unless accompanied for the entire time you are here by a parent or legal guardian. Unless a show is listed as “ALL AGES” and ends by 11PM, assume all events are 18+ unless listed as 21+.
